sources: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campsites/10133988 and /10133996 (no permitted equipment or lengths posted)

values.note: Pay at the fee tube at the entrance kiosk or by Scan & Pay (first come, first served sites: QR code only at the kiosk).

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/dpg/recreation/buffalo-gap-campground ('Overnight Use: Single Site: $20 per night'); recreation.gov rates 2026 PeakRVNonelectric 20 / WalkInRVNonelectric 20, read 2026-11-12

values.note: Paved parking pads; some take up to 60 ft. Two loops (Mandan, Hidatsa).

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/dpg/recreation/buffalo-gap-campground ('The Buffalo Gap Campground offers 36 campsites'; 'Some campsites accommodate up to 60' on paved parking pads'; the description also says '35 paved campsites'); recreation.gov catalog: 36 RV NONELECTRIC sites, read 2026-11-12

values.note: Two comfort stations with sinks, flush toilets and three showers (showers mid-May to mid-October); running water is turned off in winter. One vault toilet. Group picnic pavilion near the entrance. Campground host Thursday-Sunday, Memorial Day to Labor Day.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/dpg/recreation/buffalo-gap-campground ('two comfort stations with sinks, flush toilets, three showers (mid-May to mid-October), and one vault toilet'; 'Running water (showers, water spigots, restrooms) is available from spring to fall seasons (turned off during winter)'), read 2026-11-12

values.note: Reservations are sold for the peak season only (Memorial Day weekend to early September); the rest of the year every site is first come, first served.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/dpg/recreation/buffalo-gap-campground ('Five sites are available for reservations on Recreation.gov'; 'Stay limit of 14 consecutive days'); recreation.gov rates 2026: 'Peak Season' 05-23..09-08, 'First-come, First-served Season' 01-01..05-22 and 09-09..12-31, read 2026-11-12

note: Little Missouri National Grassland campground ~6 mi W of Medora at I-94 exit 18 (Forest Road 726A), among colorful buttes on the Buffalo Gap Trail, which links to the Maah Daah Hey. A short, steep viewpoint trail climbs a scoria hill to an overlook. Horses are not allowed in the campground; trailhead parking is at the entrance. --Claude
summary: FS page and rec.gov agree: $20/night, no hookups, 36 sites with paved pads up to 60 ft, flush toilets + showers (mid-May to mid-Oct) + vault toilet, 14-day limit, reservable in peak season on rec.gov (FS says 5 sites, catalog 16), FCFS otherwise. Season year_round already manual (not rewritten). FS page contradicts itself on drinking water; dump station is not on the FS page or rec.gov.
flags: WATER CONTRADICTION: the FS page says 'Potable water is not available at this site.' and in the same section 'Running water (showers, water spigots, restrooms) is available from spring to fall seasons (turned off during winter).' rec.gov amenities list 'Drinking Water'. Stored potable_water true (derived) is left alone; reviewer call.

DUMP: stored dump true (derived from old note prose) is not supported by the FS page or the rec.gov amenity list (neither mentions a dump station). Not contradicted, so left; reviewer may want it cleared.

FIT / EQUIPMENT: rec.gov's catalog posts no permitted equipment or lengths for any of the 36 sites (all typed RV NONELECTRIC). The FS page says 'Tent camping and trailer camping spots are available ... Some campsites accommodate up to 60' on paved parking pads.' A 23-ft motorhome fits.
RESERVABLE COUNT: FS page says five reservable sites; rec.gov catalog marks 16 reservable (Mandan loop sites 3-17 and Hidatsa 27). Booking note avoids a number.
OHV: FS page lists 'OHV Road Riding' only as a district-wide rule (OHVs may only enter and exit sites on designated roads inside campgrounds); trails are non-motorized. Not an OHV staging campground.
FIRE: Little Missouri National Grassland fire restriction order 01-18-00-26-02 in effect (restriction, not closure).
SEASON: year_round with manual provenance (2026-11-08) confirmed by 'Open year-round. Limited services after Labor Day and before Memorial Day.'; not rewritten.
PHONE: 701-227-7800 (Medora Ranger District) confirmed. WEBSITE: both links confirmed.
